source_gate: shared semantic policy and read-only lint tool present
technical_build: no new overfull boxes vs named baseline
whole_document_render: every PDF page rendered and inspected
captions, tables, math and figures readable
logo SHA and page appearance where required
no clipping, spill, orphaned pages or unintended blank pages
researcher-action/internal audit language absent from student-facing PDF
audit PDF has unmistakable internal banner/watermark and cannot be confused with thesis
review actual cover post-logo spacing against current university/approved researcher stage; default is not an automatic 30pt norm

release_decisions.format_approval: only after all applicable PU source obligations are verified
release_decisions.provider_upload: requires permission, correct folder, stable ID and readback

semantic_manuscript_review: Review student authorial perspective; never force first person where institution expects objective third person
Check for printed administrative identifiers or photo codes in captions/headings without deleting private source identifiers
Verify that photographs do not become quantified case counts or causal proof by implication
Match every claimed site, date, method, sample, measured cost and delay to actual project records
Verify that research assistants and disclosure are represented accurately under institution rules
Require reviewer approval of factual content; advisory lint is not a science pass
